ideas.name: Bird-safe window decal sets (Nordic species)
ideas.concept: UV-reflective, removable window decal sets designed as a coherent art system to prevent bird strikes on glazing, sold as seasonal packs.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic homeowners with large glazing, bird-feeder hobbyists
ideas.problem_solved: Birds colliding with large windows; existing decals are ugly or generic.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget and credits exhausted), so no signal was checked. Based on general knowledge of rising bird-safe glass and garden-bird interest.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Copyrighted design series, species collabs with ornithology groups, collectible seasonal drops.

ideas.name: Reusable car and garage anti-condensation pods
ideas.concept: Rechargeable (dry in oven or sun) mineral desiccant pods sized for car footwell and window-sill, with colour humidity indicator and refill granules.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic car owners, caravan, boat and garden-shed owners
ideas.problem_solved: Misted windscreens and damp interiors in winter.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live search possible. Product type exists on Amazon, so competition likely; trend stage unconfirmed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Humidity-indicator spec, refill subscription, design-led fabric housing, Nordic climate content.

ideas.name: Renter-friendly cat window-screen frame
ideas.concept: Tension-fit, no-drill mesh frame for tilt windows that lets cats enjoy fresh air safely and keeps insects out; sized to common EU window profiles.
ideas.target_customer: Cat owners in flats in SE/DK
ideas.problem_solved: Tilt windows are cat-trap hazards; balcony netting needs drilling.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live search possible. Indoor-cat and renter growth is assumed, not checked.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Window-industry fit knowledge (profile sizes, sash tolerances), design registration, safety test data.

ideas.name: Balcony rail planter clip system
ideas.concept: Modular clip-on planter and trellis brackets that fit common balcony rail profiles with wind-load tested straps; refill soil/seed pods optional.
ideas.problem_solved: Falling planters, rail damage, wind; poor fit across rails.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live search possible. Balcony gardening growth assumed from general knowledge.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design patent/registered design on clip geometry; compatibility chart; wind-load test claim.

ideas.name: Pet-door and cat-flap draught seal kit
ideas.concept: Magnetic brush-and-gasket insert to retrofit existing cat/dog flaps, cutting draughts in Nordic winters.
ideas.target_customer: Pet owners with flaps in older doors
ideas.problem_solved: Cold draughts and heat loss around pet flaps.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live search possible; energy-cost-driven draught-proofing interest assumed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Building-physics expertise, fit chart by flap brand, design registration.

ideas.name: Terrace and garden-furniture winter cover and moisture kit
ideas.concept: Breathable covers with integrated vent flaps and reusable desiccant strips to prevent mould on stored cushions and furniture.
ideas.problem_solved: Mould and mildew from non-breathable covers over winter.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no live search possible; supply of generic covers is large, so differentiation is the vent and desiccant element.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Ventilation design from building-physics know-how, branded kit with refill strips.
